item.title: TB 26-04 Webbings for Use in Elevated Oxygen Environments
item.description: Flammability test results for commercial-off-the-shelf webbings that meet NASA flammability requirements are reported for use in elevated oxygen environments anticipated for future lunar and Martian missions. item.title: NASA, SpaceX Advance Wind Tunnel Tests for Starship Rocket
item.description: NASA and its industry partners are preparing for next year’s Artemis III demonstration mission by completing new wind tunnel tests on SpaceX’s Super Heavy Version 3 rocket booster. item.title: NIH Extramural Loan Repayment Programs: Simplified Structure, Continued Commitment
item.description: The NIH Loan Repayment Programs (LRPs) are programs established by Congress and designed to recruit and retain highly qualified health professionals into biomedical or biobehavioral research careers. Applications for FY 2027 Extramural LRP awards will be accepted from September 1 until November 19, 2026.

item.title: Release of U.S. Government Policy for Stopping High-Risk Life Sciences Research
item.description: On July 28, 2026, the Administration released the U.S. Government Policy for Stopping High-Risk Life Sciences Research, pursuant to Executive Order 14292 on "Improving the Safety and Security of Biological Research.” This new government-wide policy defines areas of life sciences research that pose the greatest risk to our nation's security, implements federal funding prohibitions, and establishes a framework for addressing risk and ensuring compliance.
